varieties.name: Helios
varieties.traits: Oval shaped, dark green smooth leaves; upright growth habit; good disease resistance package (downy mildew); wide adaptability
varieties.note: Sakata F1 hybrid — confirmed to be true spinach (Spinacia oleracea), not Swiss chard: the brochure's table of contents lists 'Spinach' and 'Swiss Chard' as separate product categories, and this cultivar sits under the 'SPINACH - F1 Hybrid' heading. 'Wide adaptability' is the only climate-fitness claim; no SA zone or region is named.
